testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/pdp/verify-add-to-wishlist-functionality-on-pdp-for-guest-user.spec.ts > Webstore - PDP > verify add to wishlist functionality on pdp for guest user

scenario.summary: Guest searches the webstore for a product by SKU, opens its PDP, hovers the wishlist heart (tooltip 'Add to Wishlist') and clicks it; the guest is told to log in to add a product to the wishlist. Read-only.
steps: Open the webstore as a guest (empty storageState).
Search the product SKU, assert 'Showing 1 of 1 Results', open the result and check the product image.
Assert the wishlist heart is visible, hover it and check the tooltip.
Click the heart and check the login-required alert.
assertions: Search shows 'Showing 1 of 1 Results' and the product image is visible.
Wishlist heart visible; tooltip reads 'Add to Wishlist'.
Alert contains 'Please login to add a product to your Wishlist.'
evidence: Title 'verify add to wishlist functionality on pdp for guest user' and step labels 1) and 2) match the flow; spec comment refers to the export's validateBundleProductDetails.

Profile: z-1234579 FOUND as active BundleProduct, PRODUCTION, inventory 28362, storefrontProductIndex 1, requiredAddOnCount 0: meets PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IN_STOCK. Any searchable PDP product would do; the bundle key keeps the recorded product as the preferred record.
quantityUsed 1: nothing is added to the cart; the product only needs to be in stock and searchable.
swap: data only through loadData (productSKU -> sku), no derived assertions (tooltip, alert and 'Showing 1 of 1 Results' are fixed UI text), no data value in the spec code, no other data file.

sources.value: Please login to add a product to your Wishlist.
